link_level: public compound and library; separate image and RNA measurements
family_rule: Among component-position groups passing support thresholds, choose the largest norm of the median core program vector after per-program standardization across the RNA context. Choose the lowest-norm eligible group at the same position as comparator.
member_rule: Among compounds with at least three valid ZS13 crops, choose the core program vector nearest the family's full-member median; break ties by public compound ID.
crop_rule: Within the chosen compound, use the crop nearest its four-marker median in log1p cell-intensity space divided by the panel-wide interquartile range; break ties by crop index.
crop_filters: Mapped public non-control compound, uncensored, n_cells > 0, finite nonnegative values for the four marker means, and matching core recipe coordinates.
display_rule: One linear grayscale range per channel, calculated across both selected raw crops and shared between their rows. Raw arrays remain unchanged.
